outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Commercial Litigation page
outreach_draft.body:
Luis, I was looking through The Law Office of Luis Baez site and noticed that you clearly position the firm around both criminal defense and commercial litigation, but those two very different client needs are currently sharing the same main website conversation. A dedicated Commercial Litigation page could give business clients a much clearer path to understand the kinds of disputes you handle, the situations where you step in, and why your trial background matters to them. It would also give Google a more focused service context and make the firm’s commercial work easier for AI-driven search and assistants to interpret. I’d use Commercial Litigation as the first mockup because it is materially different from criminal defense and currently has the most room for a distinct client journey. I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
